If open people are curious about ideas, extraverts are curious about other people.

specificFindings: Joy hooked is captivated interest, not physical entrapment or a clinical addiction diagnosis. Wanted to visit every park is a subsequent aim rather than proof of already completing every visit.
Besides and also add abilities to opportunities and resources, rather than replacing those conditions or guaranteeing richness from a degree.

Ramo aerospace-engineer profession is separate from his obituary rating, Caltech degree, and later work.103 is death age,100 the final-patent age,62 a book count; the unit of each number is preserved.
Tennis strategy adds another interest and one book; it does not establish a professional athletic career or make all his books about tennis.
Registered opportunist is framed by great sense of humor. It is a quoted humorous personal response, not independently verified party registration or advice for readers.
Louis Cha and Jin Yong are two names of one novelist. The Straits Times carries his obituary; it is not thereby his employer. Shanghai journalism precedes the newspapers Hong Kong office in the1950s.

Martial-arts history inspires fiction written1955–1972; inspiration does not establish every plot as historical fact. Rereading, revising and crying at a characters breakup are distinct from writing new novels.

Unconventional, even defiant intensifies a character description without a clinical diagnosis. The articles and assassination-list consequence are explicitly attributed to this books account, not claimed as independently verified historical research.
Singapore is the stated refuge, almost a year the approximate duration, and avoiding assassination the stated purpose. No exact dates, permanent residence or unstated occupation are invented.

Openness and intellect are two subfactors within openness to experience, not the whole Big Five. Must have been is the authors retrospective inference from achievements and emotional imagination, not measured trait scores.
While contrasts how obvious the two links seem. Extraversion is framed as social-world exploration and openness as sensory/abstract exploration; curiosity interests are not made mutually exclusive.

The party question introduces an everyday contrast, not a request for personal data. Gravitate toward familiar people is a tendency and can accompany deeper conversation, not avoidance of all social contact.
The different-strategy sentence signals a contrast; the following opening action is talking to new people and making friends. It does not guarantee every new conversation becomes a friendship.
